cvEn:
Gil (Gili) Reuveni, son of Tova and Sami, was born on the 11th of Iyar 5725 (13 May 1965) in Givatayim. He was the youngest of three children. Gil studied at the Hess Elementary School in Tel Aviv, at the Ofakim Middle School, and at the ORT Technikum, where he specialized in electronics.

In July 1983, Gil was drafted for compulsory service in the IDF and was sent to continue his studies through the Technological Reserve (Atuda Teknologit). He graduated as an electronics technician. After completing his basic military training, he was posted to the Air Force base at Tel Nof. According to his commanders, Gil excelled in his work and his role. He was considered wise and capable, and he had an exceptionally high professional ability in the field of electronics. Gil loved his work and contributed to the unit to the best of his ability. He was sent from time to time to advanced training courses that advanced him in his field, and he even received awards for efficiency proposals he submitted.

In July 1986, Gil signed on for a career in the army. During the course of his service he was promoted to Staff Sergeant.

On the 7th of Elul 5747 (31 August 1987), Gil fell during his service. He was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Holon. He left behind his parents and two sisters, Adi and Talia. In a letter of condolence to the bereaved family, the unit commander wrote: "Gil served for a long period, during which his professionalism, his warmth, and his attitude toward his comrades stood out. He contributed to advancing many matters in the unit, submitting efficiency proposals for improvement and progress."
